themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Covers the use of autonomous AI agents to perform research tasks, from data collection to analysis, often with a focus on their capabilities and limitations.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Focuses on AI tools that help developers write, review, and debug code, including their security implications and efficiency.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Explores various AI-powered platforms and tools designed to aid researchers in their work, from discovery to analysis.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Discusses the creation and use of AI-generated users for research, testing, and analysis, along with associated ethical and practical concerns.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Highlights AI tools and techniques for summarizing large amounts of text, such as research papers, earnings calls, and articles.

themes.name: AI customer insights
themes.description: Covers the application of AI in gathering, analyzing, and leveraging customer data to drive business decisions and improve experiences.

themes.name: AI sentiment feedback
themes.description: Focuses on AI's role in analyzing user sentiment from various sources like social media, reviews, and customer feedback.

themes.name: AI for design research
themes.description: Examines how AI is being integrated into the design process to assist with research, ideation, and the creation of user interfaces and experiences.

themes.name: AI survey tools
themes.description: Features AI applications and platforms specifically designed to enhance survey creation, distribution, and analysis, including bias detection.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Investigates the use of AI chatbots in research contexts, including their accuracy, potential for misinformation, and role in user interaction.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
